forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2022 real GDP growth
evidence_summary: Fed projected 4.0 percent Q4-over-Q4 real GDP growth; BEA later reported 0.9 percent.
interpretation: Forecast materially exceeded the observed annual growth rate.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2022 unemployment
evidence_summary: Fed projected 3.5 percent unemployment; BLS annual average was 3.6 percent.
interpretation: Forecast was very close to the observed outcome.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2022 PCE inflation
evidence_summary: Fed projected 2.6 percent Q4-over-Q4 PCE inflation; BEA later reported 5.7 percent.
interpretation: Inflation substantially exceeded the projection.

forecast_text: IEA expected more than 198 GW of renewable additions in 2020
evidence_summary: IEA forecast roughly 198 GW while IRENA later reported more than 260 GW added.
interpretation: Observed renewable additions materially exceeded the forecast.

forecast_text: IEA expected nearly 107 GW of global solar PV additions in 2020
evidence_summary: IEA forecast nearly 107 GW; IRENA reported 127 GW of solar additions.
interpretation: Solar deployment exceeded the forecast.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2023 real GDP growth
evidence_summary: Fed projected 0.5 percent Q4-over-Q4 growth; BEA reported 3.1 percent.
interpretation: Economic growth substantially exceeded the projection.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2023 unemployment
evidence_summary: Fed projected 4.6 percent unemployment; unemployment was about 3.7 percent at year-end.
interpretation: The labor market remained materially stronger than projected.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2023 PCE inflation
evidence_summary: Fed projected 3.1 percent Q4-over-Q4 PCE inflation; BEA reported 2.7 percent.
interpretation: Inflation finished moderately below the projection.

forecast_text: IEA expected 270 GW of renewable capacity additions in 2021
evidence_summary: IEA forecast 270 GW; year-end reporting indicated almost 290 GW.
interpretation: Renewable deployment modestly exceeded the forecast.

forecast_text: IEA expected 280 GW of renewable capacity additions in 2022
evidence_summary: IEA forecast 280 GW; later IEA reporting put 2022 additions near 340 GW.
interpretation: Deployment materially exceeded the earlier forecast.

forecast_text: IEA expected 162 GW of solar PV additions in 2022
evidence_summary: IEA forecast 162 GW; later IEA reporting put 2022 solar additions near 220 GW.
interpretation: Solar deployment significantly exceeded the earlier forecast.

forecast_text: IEA expected renewable additions to exceed 300 GW in 2022
evidence_summary: IEA expected more than 300 GW; later reporting showed nearly 340 GW.
interpretation: The realized outcome came in above the forecast threshold.

forecast_text: IEA expected global electric car sales to reach 14 million in 2023
evidence_summary: IEA forecast 14 million EV sales for 2023; later reporting showed about 14 million.
interpretation: The forecast was very close to the realized outcome.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2024 real GDP growth
evidence_summary: Fed projected 1.4 percent Q4-over-Q4 real GDP growth; later historical data show about 2.4 percent.
interpretation: Growth substantially exceeded the earlier projection.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2024 unemployment
evidence_summary: Fed projected 4.1 percent unemployment; later historical data show about 4.1 percent.
interpretation: The forecast was very close to the realized outcome.

forecast_text: FOMC median projection for 2024 PCE inflation
evidence_summary: Fed projected 2.4 percent PCE inflation; later historical data show about 2.6 percent.
interpretation: Inflation finished modestly above the projection.

forecast_text: IEA expected global electric car sales to reach around 17 million in 2024
evidence_summary: IEA projected around 17 million EV sales; actual sales exceeded 17 million.
interpretation: The forecast was very close to the realized outcome.

forecast_text: IEA central estimate expected global electric car sales to exceed 2.3 million in 2020.
evidence_summary: IEA expected sales above 2.3 million; preliminary actual sales exceeded 3 million.
interpretation: EV sales materially exceeded the pandemic-era forecast threshold.

forecast_text: IEA forecast 167 GW of renewable capacity additions in 2020.
evidence_summary: IEA's May forecast was 167 GW; later 2020 reporting put additions at about 198 GW.
interpretation: Renewable deployment recovered faster than the earlier pandemic forecast anticipated.

forecast_text: IEA expected solar PV additions to exceed 90 GW in 2020.
evidence_summary: IEA expected more than 90 GW; later reporting estimated about 107 GW.
interpretation: Solar additions exceeded the earlier forecast threshold.
